note: Hand-authored accept/reject corpus for the resolved plan's `archive_guard` scope, read by scripts/ci/test_schema.py and tools/test-toolkit/tests/ci_workflow_contracts.rs. Adding a case here fails both suites until both readers agree on it. Unlike contract.json this file is not generated: it states behavior schema.py's field table cannot.

cases.name: unselected-scope
cases.rule: An unselected guard describes no scope and still says why.

cases.name: full-scan
cases.rule: A full scan names no paths.

cases.name: changed-scan
cases.rule: A changed scan names its sorted, unique, repository-relative paths.

archive_guard.reason: the pull_request event carries a change inventory

cases.name: empty-changed-scan
cases.rule: An explicitly empty list is the real "nothing eligible changed" state, never an implicit full scan.

cases.name: unknown-field
cases.rule: The field set is closed; a scope field a reader does not know is one it cannot apply.

archive_guard.reason: a renamed scope field must not be silently ignored

cases.name: non-object-scope-array
cases.rule: The scope is an object; a list carries no field to read.

cases.name: non-object-scope-number
cases.rule: The scope is an object; a number carries no field to read.

cases.name: missing-selected
cases.rule: Every scope declares whether the guard was selected.

archive_guard.reason: a scope with no selection decides nothing

cases.name: non-boolean-selected
cases.rule: `selected` is a boolean; a string is not a decision.

archive_guard.reason: a quoted boolean is a string

cases.name: unselected-carrying-mode
cases.rule: Stale scope beside an unselected guard would scan as if it had been planned.

cases.name: unselected-carrying-paths
cases.rule: Stale scope beside an unselected guard would scan as if it had been planned.

cases.name: selected-without-mode
cases.rule: A selected guard names the scan it was given.

cases.name: unknown-mode
cases.rule: `full` and `changed` are the whole vocabulary; anything else has no defined scope.

archive_guard.reason: a partial scan is not a mode

cases.name: full-scan-carrying-paths
cases.rule: A listed subset beside a full scan would read as the whole of what was checked.

archive_guard.reason: a full scan takes no path list

cases.name: changed-scan-without-paths
cases.rule: An empty scan is spelled as an explicit empty list, never as an absent one.

archive_guard.reason: a changed scan with no list

cases.name: changed-scan-with-non-array-paths
cases.rule: `paths` is a list; one string is not a one-element scope.

archive_guard.reason: a bare string is not a path list

cases.name: changed-scan-with-non-string-path
cases.rule: Every listed path is a string.

cases.name: unsorted-paths
cases.rule: One order per scope, so two readers of one plan cannot disagree about it.

cases.name: duplicate-paths
cases.rule: A scope names each path once.

cases.name: windows-spelled-path
cases.rule: One POSIX spelling per path, so a Windows-spelled diff resolves the same scope.

cases.name: escaping-path
cases.rule: Every path is resolved against the checkout root; a `..` component walks out of it without ever looking absolute.

archive_guard.reason: a path that leaves the checkout

cases.name: absolute-path
cases.rule: An absolute path discards the checkout root it is joined against.

cases.name: drive-prefixed-path
cases.rule: A Windows drive prefix discards the checkout root the same way an absolute path does.

cases.name: missing-reason
cases.rule: Every scope states why it holds the scope it does.

cases.name: blank-reason
cases.rule: Whitespace explains nothing.

cases.name: non-string-reason
cases.rule: A reason is prose, not a number.
